pairs.question: Indica mihi quem diligit anima mea ubi pascas ubi cubes in meridie ne vagari incipiam per greges sodalium tuorum?
pairs.answer: Si ignoras te o pulchra inter mulieres egredere et abi post vestigia gregum et pasce hedos tuos iuxta tabernacula pastorum.
pairs.derivation: The bride asks where her beloved pastures and rests at noon (v.6); the reply (v.7) directly answers with the instruction to go out and follow the flocks. Whole verse 6 kept as the interrogative; answer is the full verse 7, a single contiguous response.

pairs.question: Quae est ista quae ascendit per desertum sicut virgula fumi ex aromatibus murrae et turis et universi pulveris pigmentarii?
pairs.answer: En lectulum Salomonis sexaginta fortes ambiunt ex fortissimis Israhel.
pairs.derivation: Question 'who is this coming up from the desert?' (v.6) is answered by the identification in v.7 (behold Solomon's litter). Answer stopped at the first full sentence; v.8 onward elaborates on the guards and is omitted.

pairs.question: Qualis est dilectus tuus ex dilecto o pulcherrima mulierum qualis est dilectus tuus ex dilecto quia sic adiurasti nos?
pairs.answer: Dilectus meus candidus et rubicundus electus ex milibus.
pairs.derivation: The daughters of Jerusalem ask what her beloved is like (whole v.9 quoted contiguously as the question). The reply opens the description; answer cut to the first sentence (v.10); the ensuing catalogue of his features (vv.11ff) is elaboration and omitted.

pairs.question: Quo abiit dilectus tuus o pulcherrima mulierum quo declinavit dilectus tuus et quaeremus eum tecum?
pairs.answer: Dilectus meus descendit in hortum suum ad areolam aromatis ut pascatur in hortis et lilia colligat.
pairs.derivation: The daughters ask where her beloved has gone (v.17); the bride answers that he went down to his garden (6.1). Answer is the full single sentence of 6.1; v.6.2 ('ego dilecto meo...') turns to a separate declaration and is omitted.

pairs.question: Soror nostra parva et ubera non habet quid faciemus sorori nostrae in die quando adloquenda est?
pairs.answer: Si murus est aedificemus super eum propugnacula argentea si ostium est conpingamus illud tabulis cedrinis.
pairs.derivation: The deliberative question 'what shall we do for our sister?' (v.8, kept with its setup so 'sorori nostrae' has a referent) is answered by the conditional plan in v.9. Answer is the whole of v.9.
